sources.title: glm-5.3-flash
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in Z.ai's GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the cost, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.

sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is a 320B-total / 18B-active multimodal MoE with hybrid KDA and sparse MLA attention, native FP8 weights, MTP, and a 1M-token context window.
